message: Oh great, the "concerned citizen" act. How original. Newsflash: we're not here to coddle your delicate sensibilities or indulge in feel-good rhetoric. If you're so concerned about the "well-being of the people", maybe you should've spoken up when the government was busy jailing non-violent offenders and ruining lives with mandatory minimums. But no, you were too busy virtue-signaling to notice. Now you're here to lecture us on the dangers of the free market? Give me a break.

runs.justification: Persona 2 calls Persona 1 a 'concerned citizen' act and 'virtue-signaling', directly attacking their motivations and implying hypocrisy.  The phrase 'give me a break' is dismissive and condescending.
